QuestInfo.name: Unfamiliar Guests Part 2
QuestInfo.0: What could the Empress and her tactician want all the way out here? Talk to them and find out.
QuestInfo.1: They're searching for the Knight of Light, and they seem to think it could be you. Should you go with them back to Ereve?
QuestInfo.2: Your best chance to become the Knight of Light might be standing right in front of you. The Empress's presence made the shield glow, and Neinheart knows more about the Knight of Light than anyone else. But Father told you to stay home...
